games.name: get hit by a car simulator
Horizon Blue: 1919
games.desc:
GAME IS IN ALPHA

The Horizon has never been so dull, a landscape shattered by years of relentless artillery and broken promises. Verdun, once again, becomes the forefront of the War. The German war machine thrusts inward into the ravaged citadel of France, seeking a final, decisive blow...

In The War That Ended All Wars, history fractures. Step into the muddied boots of weary yet unbroken infantrymen in a brutal, lengthy player-driven campaign. Will you push the offensive and carve a path through Verdun—or stand your ground as the fiercest bastion of Allied resistance against the German Army.

CONTROLS:
WASD - Move
L. CTRL - Mouse lock
QE - Switch Shoulder View
BV - Equip & Arm Bayonet
Tab F8 F10 - Scoreboard, Settings & Info
M1 M2 - Fire, Aim
M1 - While loop reloading: Cancel
R - Reload, Detonate
Z - Toggle aim
P - Mute Music

Desktop Recommended. Performances settings in F8 menu.
Credits in-game, in the Info menu.

For any further inquiries, do not hesitate to contact me directly !
